Plan before you purchase

Run your numbers.
Compare the scenarios.

Explore hypothetical monthly and yearly revenue after estimated food, packaging, and venue-share costs. Other expenses are not deducted.

Compare venue-share scenarios:

The 40% example is exploratory, not an established Frost Bot offer. Both examples assume the owner pays food and packaging expenses; actual responsibilities must be negotiated. These are hypothetical, editable assumptions—not expected results. Processing fees, labor, utilities, rent, maintenance, spoilage, financing payments, taxes, and other costs are not deducted.

Illustrative monthly revenue$2,100
Illustrative yearly revenue$25,200

Monthly revenue × 12. Assumes the same sales and operating days every month; not a forecast.

Food & packaging (20% starting assumption)$420
After food & packaging*$1,680
Venue share$210
Illustrative remainder before other expenses$1,470

*Illustrative subtotal after food and packaging. The remainder deducts only food/packaging and venue share; it is not net profit or an earnings forecast. Payment processing, labor, maintenance, utilities, equipment cost, financing, taxes, and other expenses are excluded. Sales and downtime vary.

How the calculation works

Monthly revenue = daily sales × average sale × operating days × machines. Yearly revenue = monthly revenue × 12, with no seasonality or ramp-up adjustment. Food/packaging and venue share are each calculated as percentages of total sales. Subtracting those two amounts gives an illustrative remainder before all other operating expenses.

Before you buy

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Make sure the equipment, location, and operating plan fit together.

How much does a machine cost?

Equipment starts at $14,999 before freight and other services. Done With You starts at $16,999 and Done For You starts at $17,999 under standard delivery conditions. Ask about quantity-based discounts for 2 or more machines. Final prices and inclusions are specified in a written quote.

Can I customize the machine’s wrap?

Yes. A custom wrap featuring your branding is included at no additional charge, subject to final artwork approval and standard manufacturer wrap specifications. You can also choose the signature Frost Bot blue design. The Flex Freeze and Gainz Cream designs are illustrative concepts; confirm final artwork and lead time in your quote.

Can I offer protein soft-serve?

Protein soft-serve is an option to discuss with our team. Confirm the intended recipe, mix compatibility, serving size, and menu with the equipment configuration before purchase. Nutrition varies by recipe and toppings.

What does operating the machine involve?

The customer order and dispensing process is automated. Owners still need to arrange restocking, cleaning, sanitation, routine checks, maintenance, and customer issue handling.

What utilities and space will I need?

The exact requirements depend on the model. Request its specification sheet and check power, connectivity, ventilation clearance, delivery access, and service access with your venue before installation.

Are delivery, installation, and training included?

Confirm these items in your written quote. The scope should specify shipping or delivery, setup, operator training, and any travel or site preparation charges.

Can I explore financing?

Indicate your interest in the optional form details. Ask the team about currently available options and terms. Approval, rates, and required down payments must be confirmed with the financing provider.

Is managed ownership available now?

Managed ownership is being explored, and we are inviting expressions of interest. A potential host-managed agreement depends on finding an approved host and negotiating operating duties, cost responsibilities and any revenue-sharing structure. No arrangement, income or availability is guaranteed.

How much could I earn?

Results depend on demand, pricing, location costs, operating costs, and uptime. The calculator is a planning tool with hypothetical inputs, not a forecast or guarantee. Validate your assumptions before making a purchase.

What warranty and support come with it?

Request the current written warranty and support terms with your quote, including coverage, exclusions, parts, labor, service availability, and response procedures.
